answer: Each agent identity must lock a refundable bond plus a slowly-earned reputation score, so minting a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand real stakes, not a thousand free key-pairs. Every new agent starts in a bare meadow with near-zero trust, climbing a velvet reputation ramp only through costly, verified work, and any sudden delta of fresh peers vouching for one another is flagged as a ring. Honest agents pay nothing extra, while a Sybil farm must burn capital on every fake seat just to reach the starting line, and its bond is slashed once collusion is detected.
